# kul

> Kul — a kinship description language. Small DSL for modeling families, marriages, births, and adoptions, with first-class chronology and an end-to-end Rust toolchain (parser, validator, LSP, WASM).

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/YashBhalodi/kul): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
